title: LB Omnichord drum fills instrument realization — gamma9001

separation_contract.rule: Resolve each event logical_role using fill_profile[fill_id] when present, otherwise the rhythm_profile fallback. Velocity comes from the timing catalogue and may be scaled but not used to move events.
separation_contract.quality_reference: Gamma9001 determines authored musical colour; Tiny is compatibility degradation only.

source_info.constraint: Mappings use GM note semantics through Gamma9001 patches; Latin profiles deliberately use a main kit plus patch 390 percussion roles.

gamma_kit_selection_policy.latin_rule: Profiles may use main-kit drum roles and patch 390 for Latin/hand-percussion roles. Do not collapse these to one patch if that changes the intended orchestration.
gamma_kit_selection_policy.esp32_p4_note: This is design data only. Gamma9001 storage/build integration on the P4 must be verified separately before selecting this realization at runtime.

gamma_fill_selection_policy.tiny_policy: Tiny does not mirror this colour layer; it is a compatibility/test degradation path.
gamma_fill_selection_policy.rule: F1-F5 must not collapse to one kit profile. Profile changes are deliberate orchestration, not randomness.
